baseline.name: Simulate one queue turn per purchased ticket
baseline.approach: Rotate the queue and decrement one ticket at a time until the target person finishes.
baseline.time: O(T) ticket events plus queue setup, where T is tickets bought before target completion
baseline.space: O(n) explicit queue, or O(1) indices with input mutation

archived.name: Sum each person's capped ticket contribution

why: The target's final turn determines exactly how many visits each position can receive; a formula replaces queue events.
quantitative_comparison: The simulation performs T=sum(i<=k,min(tickets[i],tickets[k]))+sum(i>k,min(tickets[i],tickets[k]-1)) ticket events. The archive evaluates n capped contributions. For n=100, all counts=100 and k=99, these are 10000 events versus 100 contributions; that 100:1 event-count example is not a measured time ratio.
tradeoffs: Does not produce the queue's intermediate history and assumes a valid k/positive bounded counts. It preserves the input.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
